statement: The site's media has one copy, in one AWS account and region: S3 versioning covers a deletion or an overwrite, not a compromised account, an account closure or a regional loss.

treatment.plan: A second copy outside the failure domain: S3 replication of the media bucket to a bucket in a second region (about 3.4 GB, well under a dollar a month), ideally under a separate account or with Object Lock. It is spending, so it waits for the owner's ok (D-325 closed list); until then versioning (90 days) is the only recovery.
